target.title: Rename the number converters' signed flag

findings.claim: Tests and documentation still use the old `signed=True` argument name instead of `allow_negative=True`.
findings.explanation: The pull request renames the `signed` parameter to `allow_negative` in `NumberConverter` and `FloatConverter`, but fails to update tests (`tests/test_routing.py`) and several parts of the docstrings in `src/werkzeug/routing/converters.py`. This will cause TypeError when routing rules use `signed=True` or stale parameter references in docstrings.
findings.suggested_fix: Update `signed=True` to `allow_negative=True` in `tests/test_routing.py` and update the parameter descriptions in the docstrings.

arguments.summary: Renames `signed` parameter of number converters to `allow_negative`, but leaves tests and parts of docstrings referencing the old `signed` parameter name.

findings.suggested_fix: Consider keeping `self.signed` as an alias or deprecating it rather than an abrupt rename.
findings.explanation: Renaming `self.signed` to `self.allow_negative` is a breaking change for any external code or third-party extensions inspecting or using `converter.signed`.
findings.claim: The attribute `self.signed` was renamed to `self.allow_negative`, but any code accessing `converter.signed` externally will break.

arguments.summary: Renames the `signed` parameter and attribute of number converters to `allow_negative`.
